latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of equipment-maintenance-log.

- Track calibration dates and maintenance intervals for lab equipment.
- Supports add, update, delete, list, and compliance report commands.
- Validates calibration date format (YYYY-MM-DD) with clear error messages.
- Generates JSON compliance reports with next due dates and maintenance status.
- Provides structured, audit-ready maintenance reminders and overdue alerts.
- Strictly scoped to lab equipment calibration and maintenance scheduling only.
